title: Lemongrass Chicken Fajitas
description: A twist on traditional fajitas, this dish combines the bright flavors of lemongrass with the spices of Mexican cuisine. Served with sautéed chicken and noodles.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the lemongrass, red bell pepper, and onion to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, chili powder, and garlic powder to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and spices.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the noodles to the skillet and cook until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
